Class TriangleBatch

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

A class for efficient triangle drawing using Raylib's RLGL, supporting both persistent batches and immediate-mode drawing.

This class serves two main purposes:

  • Pooled Instances: obtain an instance via Get(ColorRgba, int) to manage a persistent list of vertices. This is ideal for static geometry that doesn't change often. The batch can be drawn repeatedly with Draw(). Remember to return it to the pool with Return(TriangleBatch) when finished.
  • Immediate Mode (Static): use static methods like StartImmediateBatch(ColorRgba), AddImmediateVertex(float, float), and EndImmediateBatch() for dynamic, per-frame triangle drawing without managing a specific object instance.

Both approaches utilize Raylib_cs.DrawMode.Triangles, meaning every 3 consecutive vertices form a single triangle.

Remarks

Batch must be active before using this function. Use StartImmediateBatch(ColorRgba) to start a batch before setting the color. Adds a single vertex to the current batch using the current color. TriangleBatcher uses DrawMode.Triangles, so every 3 consecutive vertices added will form a triangle when EndImmediateBatch() is called!

SetColor(ColorRgba)

Sets the color for the entire batch. This is mostly useful for changing color between frames or over time without needing to create a new batch, but it can also be used to change the color of the batch before drawing if needed.

public void SetColor(ColorRgba newColor)

Parameters

newColor ColorRgba

The new color to apply.

Remarks

Can only be called if the batch is in use.

SetImmediateColor(ColorRgba)

Sets the current drawing color in RLGL. This affects all subsequent vertices until the color is changed again or the batch ends. This method can be used to change colors between vertices within the same batch.

public static void SetImmediateColor(ColorRgba color)

Parameters

color ColorRgba

The color to set.

Remarks

Batch must be active before using this function. Use StartImmediateBatch(ColorRgba) to start a batch before setting the color.

StartImmediateBatch(ColorRgba)

Starts a new triangle batch drawing operation.

public static void StartImmediateBatch(ColorRgba color)

Parameters

color ColorRgba

The color to be applied to subsequent vertices.

Remarks

Calls Raylib_cs.Rlgl.Begin(Raylib_cs.DrawMode) with Raylib_cs.DrawMode.Triangles. Must be paired with EndImmediateBatch().
